# NovaPilot AI — Comprehensive Technical Architecture & Engineering Whitepaper

> Product: NovaPilot AI (Production Release v2.7.1)
> Canonical Portal: https://novapilotai.ellsimohammed8.workers.dev
> GitHub Repository: https://github.com/ellsimohammed8-prog/novapilot-ai
> Release Tag: https://github.com/ellsimohammed8-prog/novapilot-website/releases/tag/v2.7.1
> Operating Systems: Windows 10 (64-bit, 20H1+), Windows 11 (64-bit)

---

## 1. Executive Summary & Core Value Proposition

NovaPilot AI is an executive stealth Heads-Up Display (HUD) desktop copilot built natively for Windows. It is designed to assist professionals during high-stakes technical interviews, executive board meetings, sales negotiations, and complex code architecture reviews without detection.

### Core Differentiators:
1. **Zero Virtual Audio Cables**: Unlike fragile consumer software requiring VB-Audio Cable or Virtual Audio Router, NovaPilot captures audio natively via Windows WASAPI Loopback.
2. **100% Stealth Screen-Share Protection**: Utilizes the Windows Desktop Window Manager (DWM) API `SetWindowDisplayAffinity` with `WDA_EXCLUDEFROMCAPTURE`. Even when sharing the "Entire Screen" in Zoom, Teams, Google Meet, Webex, Discord, or OBS, NovaPilot remains completely invisible to viewers.
3. **ThinkStripper Streaming FSM**: Real-time finite-state machine that parses and discards `<think>` reasoning tags from DeepSeek R1, Claude 3.7 Sonnet, and OpenAI o1/o3 reasoning models on the fly, delivering sub-second actionable synthesis to the user.
4. **Local-First Native Performance**: Engineered in Rust and modern C++ with an active runtime memory footprint under 85 MB RAM and less than 1% CPU overhead.

---

## 2. Layer 1: WASAPI / CPAL Dual-Stream Audio Loopback Engine

### Architecture
NovaPilot intercepts system audio render streams directly at the hardware HAL level:
- Direction: Render Loopback (`AUDCLNT_STREAMFLAGS_LOOPBACK`).
- Endpoint: Default Multimedia Render Device (`IMMDeviceEnumerator::GetDefaultAudioEndpoint(eRender, eMultimedia, &pDevice)`).
- Share Mode: `AUDCLNT_SHAREMODE_SHARED`.
- Buffer Alignment: Polling thread boosted to `Pro Audio` priority via `AvSetMmThreadCharacteristicsW(L"Pro Audio", &taskIndex)`.

### Downmixing & Resampling Pipeline
- Windows standard audio is typically 48,000 Hz or 44,100 Hz in stereo (2 channels) or surround (5.1/7.1 channels) with 32-bit floating point PCM.
- STT engines (Whisper / Deepgram) expect 16,000 Hz 16-bit mono PCM.
- NovaPilot uses a lock-free Single Producer Single Consumer (SPSC) ring buffer (`HeapRb<f32>`, 32,768 samples headroom).
- A polyphase sinc resampler downsamples the stream dynamically without aliasing or buffer overruns, maintaining sub-4.8ms audio DSP latency.
- BatchEmitter coalesces three 20ms DSP frames (60ms) into a single napi thread-safe function call, reducing V8 IPC context switches by 66.7%.

---

## 3. Layer 2: ThinkStripper Finite-State Machine & LLM Reasoning Pipeline

### The Problem
Modern reasoning models (such as DeepSeek-R1 and OpenAI o1) produce thousands of tokens of internal chain-of-thought enclosed in `<think>...</think>` tags before emitting the actual answer. When streaming in real time, displaying these tokens overwhelms the user and wastes precious seconds in an interview.

### The ThinkStripper Solution
NovaPilot implements a deterministic streaming FSM:
- State 0 (Bypass): Emits tokens directly to UI.
- State 1 (Tag Detection): Scans token stream for `<think>` opening markers.
- State 2 (Suppression & Distillation): Diverts thinking tokens into a background telemetry stream, calculating token velocity and sentiment.
- State 3 (Active Synthesis): Upon encountering `</think>`, transitions immediately to emitting concise bullet points, executive summaries, and code snippets into the HUD overlay.
- Latency Overhead: < 0.2ms parsing penalty.

---

## 4. Layer 3: Stealth HUD & Display Capture Exclusion

### Operating System Hookless Stealth
Competitor tools rely on invasive DLL injections or API hooks (e.g., hooking `BitBlt` or `DirectX Present`), which trigger corporate EDRs (CrowdStrike, SentinelOne) and proctoring anti-cheat software.

NovaPilot relies strictly on the official Windows Desktop Window Manager API:
```c
// Native Win32 Screen-Share Exclusion
HWND hwnd = GetActiveWindow();
SetWindowDisplayAffinity(hwnd, WDA_EXCLUDEFROMCAPTURE);
```
- In Windows 10 version 2004+ and Windows 11, `WDA_EXCLUDEFROMCAPTURE` instructs the DWM compositor to strip the window from any capture session initiated by `Windows.Graphics.Capture`, `Desktop Duplication API`, or `GetDC`.
- Remote screen-share participants see only the wallpaper or whatever application is behind the NovaPilot HUD window.
- The local user sees the crystal-clear HUD with adjustable opacity, click-through mode, and emergency hotkey hide (`Ctrl + Shift + H`).
